summary: Wide shot from the street: the guest takes a last look at the house, turns and walks out past camera; once he is gone the host drops the act and bolts back inside the burning house.
framing: Wide, eye level, static, in dusk-purple light: the guest large in the left foreground (head and shoulders), the house beyond with a garage door at left, a glowing shuttered window at centre, the open front door with the host small in it at right of centre, porch, steps, bushes, path and lawn.
